excerpt_i18n.en: On November 25, Alibaba's AI application "Qianwen" App surged in popularity again in the Hong Kong and Macau markets. Latest data shows the app has topped the free chart on Apple's App Store in Macau and entered the top three in Hong Kong's free chart. This achievement continues its strong momentum since the public beta began. On November 17, Qianwen App officially launched its public beta and reached the top three in the mainland China App Store free overall chart within just three days. By November 24, its cumulative downloads in the first week of the public beta had exceeded 10 million, surpassing ChatGPT, Sora, and DeepSeek to become the fastest-growing AI application in history. The explosive growth of Qianwen App stems from the robust technical capabilities and global influence of Alibaba's Qwen open-source model. Since its open-source release in 2023, the Qwen model has surpassed 600 million global downloads and quickly gained recognition in Silicon Valley for its superior performance. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has noted that Qwen has captured the majority of the global open-source model market. This momentum built in the B2B and developer communities has laid a solid foundation for Qianwen App's breakthrough in the consumer market. It is revealed that Qianwen App's strategic goal is to create a future AI life gateway. Alibaba plans to integrate various life scenarios such as maps, food delivery, ticket booking, office work, learning, shopping, and health into Qianwen App, equipping it with more powerful capabilities for handling tasks.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 25 de noviembre, la aplicación de IA "Qianwen" de Alibaba volvió a causar furor en los mercados de Hong Kong y Macao. Los últimos datos muestran que la aplicación ha alcanzado el primer puesto en la lista gratuita de la App Store de Apple en Macao y, al mismo tiempo, ha entrado en el top tres de la lista gratuita de Hong Kong. Este logro continúa su fuerte impulso desde el inicio de la prueba pública. El 17 de noviembre, Qianwen App comenzó oficialmente su prueba pública y, en solo tres días, entró en el top tres de la lista gratuita general de la App Store en China continental. Hasta el 24 de noviembre, las descargas acumuladas en su primera semana de prueba pública superaron los 10 millones, superando a ChatGPT, Sora y DeepSeek para convertirse en la aplicación de IA de más rápido crecimiento en la historia.
